hints.title: Prefix Sum Inversion Count
hints.text: Transform elements into +1 and -1. The task becomes counting earlier prefix sum indices with P[i] < P[j].

hints.title: Index Coordinate Shift
hints.text: Because prefix sums range from -N to +N, shift values by N + 1 into non-negative index space.

hints.title: Binary Indexed Tree
hints.text: Use a Fenwick tree to query cumulative counts strictly below current prefix sum in logarithmic time.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Fenwick:
    def __init__(self, size: int):
        self.tree = [0] * (size + 1)
        
    def add(self, idx: int, delta: int = 1):
        while idx < len(self.tree):
            self.tree[idx] += delta
            idx += idx & (-idx)
            
    def query(self, idx: int) -> int:
        s = 0
        while idx > 0:
            s += self.tree[idx]
            idx -= idx & (-idx)
        return s

class Solution:
    def countMajoritySubarrays(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
        # Transform: target -> +1, others -> -1
        # Prefix sum P[j] - P[i] > 0 <=> P[j] > P[i] for i < j
        # P values range from -N to +N. Shift by N + 1 for Fenwick index.
        n = len(nums)
        shift = n + 1
        bit = Fenwick(2 * n + 2)
        bit.add(0 + shift, 1) # P[0] = 0
        pref = 0
        ans = 0
        for x in nums:
            pref += 1 if x == target else -1
            # We want count of previous P[i] < pref <=> query((pref - 1) + shift)
            ans += bit.query((pref - 1) + shift)
            bit.add(pref + shift, 1)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Fenwick tree counting inversions on transformed prefix sums in O(N log N).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(N^2) pairwise prefix checks time out on large array limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for Fenwick tree array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize inversion counting on prefix sums and implement a Fenwick tree.
